title: Tech Note: 4D Ajax Framework Apartment Demo
author: Joe Resuello, Technical Marketing Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This step-by-step tutorial walks developers through building a Web 2.0 apartment-listing demo using the 4D Ajax Framework's Image Matrix object, the Data Filler, and a Google Maps iframe tied to record address data. It is entirely dependent on the discontinued 4DAF/4D Web 2.0 Pack stack, its Developer Hook login model, and 4DAF-specific JavaScript objects (dataMatrix), none of which exist in current 4D products. The underlying UX ideas — a photo grid of listings, a details panel populated on click, and an embedded map keyed to a selected record's address — remain a completely standard web app pattern today, just implemented with modern JS frameworks or Qodly components rather than 4DAF.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework and 4D Web 2.0 Pack were discontinued and are no longer part of any current 4D product
Modern 4D web development uses 4D's built-in Web Server and REST/ORDA-based data access with any modern JS framework instead of 4DAF-specific objects like Image Matrix
